regs_in_letter: FD&C Act (no CFR section cited in letter text)

cases.claim: “ATTR-CM can make it feel like you’re missing out. But with Amvuttra, you don’t just get a prescription, you get a ticket. One that may take you on a different journey.” | “…so you can choose your adventure, whether it’s out there or right here.” | “Don’t let ATTR-CM decide where tomorrow takes you….Amvuttra. Just the ticket for ATTR-CM.”
cases.context: Patients shown whale watching, at a football game, nature park, concert, gondola. PI: 6-MWT and KCCQ-OS worsened in both arms through Month 30; slower decline with Amvuttra.
cases.rationale: Suggests patients can be carefree, live as before diagnosis, and broadly improved QoL — not demonstrated.
cases.check: Judge: lifestyle/'carefree'/return-to-normal imagery in progressive disease where PI functional/QoL measures (e.g., 6MWT, KCCQ) still declined (slower decline ≠ improvement).

cases.claim: “It works to rapidly knock down TTR at the source”
cases.context: SUPER: In ATTR-CM, TTR protein can misfold and build up in the body, causing symptoms. Max TTR reduction by week 6; mortality/UHF first assessed at 3 months; function at 6 months.
cases.rationale: Implies faster onset of clinical effect than demonstrated; omits timeframes.
cases.check: Judge: 'rapid' mechanism/biomarker claims that imply rapid clinical benefit; require clinical-endpoint timing.
